SELECT SALARY_ID, USER_ID, CODE_DETAIL_NO, SALARY_MIN, SALARY_MAX, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM SALARY WHERE TO_NUMBER(SALARY_MIN) >= #{salaryMin} AND TO_NUMBER(SALARY_MAX) <= #{salaryMax}

SELECT s.SALARY_ID, s.USER_ID, s.CODE_DETAIL_NO, s.SALARY_MIN, s.SALARY_MAX, TO_CHAR(s.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM SALARY s JOIN COMPANY c ON s.USER_ID = c.USER_ID WHERE c.COM_NAME = #{comName}
mapper.update: UPDATE SALARY SET SALARY_ID = #{salaryId}, CODE_DETAIL_NO = #{codeDetailNo}, SALARY_MIN = #{salaryMin}, SALARY_MAX = #{salaryMax}, CREATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT SALARY_ID , USER_ID , CODE_DETAIL_NO , SALARY_MIN , SALARY_MAX , TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM SALARY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT SALARY_ID , USER_ID , CODE_DETAIL_NO , SALARY_MIN , SALARY_MAX , TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM SALARY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND CODE_DETAIL_NO = #{codeDetailNo}

SELECT user_id, code_detail_no, salary_min, salary_max, create_date,
ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN code_detail_no BETWEEN 'RANK-001' AND 'RANK-006' THEN (TO_NUMBER(salary_min) + TO_NUMBER(salary_max)) / 2 ELSE NULL END ) OVER (), 0 ) AS salaryAvgExclExec,
ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN code_detail_no BETWEEN 'RANK-007' AND 'RANK-011' THEN (TO_NUMBER(salary_min) + TO_NUMBER(salary_max)) / 2 ELSE NULL END ) OVER (), 0 ) AS salaryAvgExec,
ROUND( AVG((TO_NUMBER(salary_min) + TO_NUMBER(salary_max)) / 2) OVER (PARTITION BY code_detail_no), 0 ) AS avgByRank FROM SALARY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY code_detail_no, salary_id
